answer: An attacker spinning up many fake agents must fund every bond, so cost scales linearly with identity count. Sybil resistance here relies on stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a minimum bond before proposing work, and reputation accrues only on that bonded key. Consider the ember of reputation glowing behind each prism of verified stake, with honest agents standing on a ledge above forgers: one false attestation slashes the full bond, making mass impersonation economically irrational.
